context: Bounded deep-independent owner-specific current received data, active identity/version/phase/objective, advisory public rules, captured private notes or explicit UNKNOWN; never live native/journal callbacks

EXEC3 owner/context isolation and stale epoch/map/plan-version response denial
EXEC4 singleflight, logical timeout retains physical ownership, cancellation/cleanup and reconnect fencing
preservation: No default legacy changes; preserve approved REST progress/stand/arrival ownership, approved planner/capture/runtime/decoder, and old testcase IDs
exclusions: Automatic admission dispatch or broad chat/event/question surfaces in this first slice
Native lifecycle rewrite or generic concurrency framework
